milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the granite stairs structure (centered at ~7, ~0, ~5 spawn-relative) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located the landmark. Target is the center of the granite stairs pyramid. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because mining pink concrete with a pickaxe causes the block to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no pink_concrete in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over voxel counting because the item ending up in inventory is the definitive proof of a successful mine action.

Uses inventory_has because the meaningful completion of 'open inventory' in this task chain is verifying that the mined pink_concrete is present. Simply opening inventory is trivial and always possible — the real check is that the player has the pink_concrete item, confirming the full task chain (find → mine → verify collection). The inventory_has rule checks inventory contents which implicitly requires the inventory state to be observable.
